measurement.statistic: median of per-sample maximum-rank elapsed time
measurement.inputs: two reproducible nonzero GPU Philox payloads

limitations: Explicit positive communication budgets: new postprocessing has no validated Auto model.
QKV postprocess head_dim=128, complete-head route, rows multiple of64.
OProj full-hidden RMSNorm hidden<=16384, capacity checked; preserves BF16 residual sum.
Qwen3 CP8 QKV needs unimplemented KV replication; no artificial extra KV heads.
Qwen2.5 bias, BLOOM ALiBi/LayerNorm, KDA and MLA special routing not validated here.
Long-context operator extrapolation is not a model-quality/context-length claim.
Two Llama405B CP4 OProj points remain numerical failures, not memory skips.
OProj is below1.9P; this baseline is released with disclosed limitations.
separated_control_note: Independent matched-config controls; some final selected configurations differ. Do not divide final primary rows by older separated times and call that a matched comparison.
provenance_note: Each direction uses one tested binary; QKV and OProj binaries differ. Per-row source/binary/environment/artifact hashes identify retained raw evidence. No tuning history or profile files are bundled.
